name: 眼棱
description: 对本棋子4格内1个敌方棋子造成等同于本棋子攻击力的法术伤害，并使本棋子恢复等量生命。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 4, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var dmgResult = dealDamage(caster, target, caster.attack, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); var actualDamage = dmgResult.damage || 0; var healResult = healDamage(caster, caster, actualDamage, battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '释放眼棱，对' + target.name + '造成' + actualDamage + '点伤害并恢复' + healResult.heal + '点生命值' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '对4格内1个敌方棋子造成' + piece.attack + "点法术伤害，并治疗本棋子等量生命。", expectedValues: { damage: piece.attack, heal: piece.attack } }; }
